subject: Request: Promotional asset rights in exchange for renewal discount
messages:
From: Samuel Park <samuel.park@nimbushealth.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood + Nimbus — promo assets & renewal discount

Hi David,

Thanks for the renewal walkthrough last week. Nimbus is excited about continuing with Redwood, but procurement asked if we can get a modest concession to justify the multi-year commit. We value a stronger partnership (and the product has been great).

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a 15% renewal discount if Nimbus agrees to a short customer case study (2–3 page write-up), an on-site quote, and permission to use the Nimbus logo on Redwood’s partner/customer pages for 12 months? We can commit to a short testimonial video as well.

I attached a mutual action plan that reflects our requested timeline and deliverables. Happy to jump on a call to align.

Best,
Samuel
Account Lead, Nimbus Health
attachments: Nimbus_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood + Nimbus — promo assets & renewal discount

Marissa / Laura — forwarding Nimbus’ ask. High level: customer is willing to do a short case study + logo use for 12 months in exchange for ~15% off on a 2-year renewal. Deal size ~$420k ARR.

Why I'm escalating: the ask is a non-standard marketing rights window (12 months, public use, testimonial video) tied to a material discount. Legal: please confirm any constraints around logo usage and testimonial language; do we need a separate marketing release form or is the standard case study template sufficient?

Marissa — is 15% within deal desk delegated authority? If not, can you route to execs with recommended tradeoff? We want to avoid losing momentum — Nimbus is calendar-driven.

Thanks,
David
Sr. Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 08:33:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood + Nimbus — promo assets & renewal discount

Vivek — quick escalation. David has Nimbus ready to sign a 2-year renewal if we provide a 15% concession in exchange for a 12-month marketing window (case study, logo on site, quote, short video). Deal: ~420k ARR; renewal closes EOM Feb.

My read: 15% is a bit high relative to standard renew-algorithms — we typically cap at 10% for this cohort without exec signoff. Proposed approvable trade: 12% if we secure a co-marketing webinar and the case study is published within 60 days of signature. Alternatively, approve full 15% if we get perpetual use of the quote (but not the logo) and a feature highlight in our enterprise newsletter.

Legal (Laura) flagged two items in the attached draft marketing-license: (1) avoid perpetual logo license without exec signoff, (2) add a clause limiting sublicensing and clarifying approval steps for the case study copy. Attaching the draft outline and proposed license.

Decision needed: approve discount range and which marketing rights we can promise. Timebox: we should commit to respond to Nimbus within 48 hours to keep momentum.

—Marissa
Head of Strategic Sales Operations
attachments: draft-case-study-outline.docx, proposed-marketing-license-terms.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jan 2027 14:09:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood + Nimbus — promo assets & renewal discount

Team — reviewed the draft license. Key legal notes:

- We should not promise logo use beyond 12 months without explicit exec approval; the customer’s suggested 12 months is acceptable but marketing should confirm where the logo will appear.
- Add an approval right for Nimbus over any quote or case study copy (standard 5-business-day review).
- Remove any broad sublicensing language — Redwood cannot grant third-party sublicenses on Nimbus’ marks.
- Add a data privacy callout clarifying that case study will not include PHI and must be scrubbed of any patient-level info.

If execs approve the 15% discount, legal can finalize the marketing release within 24 hours with the above edits. Otherwise, if discount capped at 12% under deal desk rules, legal will finalize with the same edits.

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal — Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Approval: 15% concession with conditions

Team — after reviewing the context, revenue impact, and legal notes, I approve the 15% renewal concession for Nimbus Health under the following conditions: 

1) Marketing rights limited to: a 12-month logo placement on our partner page, a 2–3 page case study, one short testimonial video (no PHI).
2) Nimbus must provide approval on final copy within 5 business days; Redwood may publish after approval.
3) We secure a co-marketing webinar with Nimbus scheduled within 90 days of signature (joint promotional plan required).
4) Legal to finalize and send the marketing license and case study release; no sublicensing; include privacy clause to exclude PHI.
5) Finance to ensure the 15% concession is applied only to the first-year ARR; second-year pricing reverts to standard renewal multiplier (documented in SOW addendum).

Marissa — please notify David to communicate terms to Nimbus and have legal attach the finalized release. Jonas — ensure finance hooks into the deal desk to apply the pricing configuration.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed-marketing-license-terms.pdf
